errors.text_span: beginnt am linken Rand der x-Achse
errors.evidence: The line starts on the y-axis at a high y-value. The phrase "am linken Rand der x-Achse" (at the left edge of the x-axis) is ambiguous and could be misinterpreted as the line starting at y=0. A clearer phrasing would be "beginnt auf der y-Achse" (begins on the y-axis).
